[{"insert":"Low Incline DB Bench Press Progression

The final low incline dumbbell bench session of the cycle. The low incline angle sits just above flat, which keeps more demand on the mid chest while also targeting the upper chest. Reps drop further this week, which means this should be the heaviest dumbbell pressing work of the six weeks. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
